title: Grounding
instructions: Feet flat on the ground. Take a deep inhale, then a slow exhale. Release tension in your body and shoulders.

title: Belly breathing sounds
instructions: Deep breath, then use all your air on 'shhh' (quietening someone), 'vrrr' (a racing car) or 'brrr' (a bumble bee) — control from the abdomen.

title: Sigh out
instructions: Diaphragmatic breath, sigh out on 'ss', 'ff' and 'sh' for as long as is comfortable.

title: Voiced sigh
instructions: Sing out a breath on 'mmm', 'vvv' and 'zzz'.

title: Shoulder rolls
instructions: Sit straight. Five big rolls, forwards or backwards.

title: Side head lean
instructions: Lean your head toward one shoulder, then the other.

title: Chin tuck and lift
instructions: Chin to chest; then chin up with the back of the head toward the shoulders.

title: Shoulders to ears
instructions: Lift your shoulders up to your ears and hold.

title: Side stretch
instructions: Stretch one arm over the head to open the ribs. Both sides.

title: Cheek massage
instructions: Heel of hand, circular motion in the dimples of the cheeks, massaging toward the lips.

title: Jaw massage
instructions: Fingers where the jaw meets near the ears. Circular motion.

title: Tongue stretch
instructions: Stretch the tongue toward the chin as far as comfortable.

title: Tongue figure 8
instructions: Draw figure 8s or infinity signs with the tongue inside the mouth.

title: Fist squeeze
instructions: Squeeze fingers into a tight fist, hold, release and feel the tension release. Repeat with toes.

title: Face scrunch
instructions: Scrunch the whole face, then release.

title: Princess sigh
instructions: A high-pitched sigh, as if a princess whose animals have done all her jobs for her.

title: "ng" siren
instructions: Make an 'ng' as in 'sing', slide between high and low like a siren. Smile to help open resonance.

title: Nee-naw siren
instructions: The same 'ng' sound in a nee-naw siren pattern.

title: Lip or tongue trill
instructions: Lick lips and blow a raspberry. If you can't do a lip trill, use a tongue trill. Move the pitch around.

title: Whoop
instructions: A 'whoop' from your lowest pitch to your highest, and back.

title: Yawn-sigh (tongue flat)
instructions: Yawn and sigh, stretching the jaw wide. Keep the tongue flat.
tip: The urge to yawn while talking is a sign you're holding tongue tension — stretching relaxes it.

title: Yawn-sigh (tongue up)
instructions: Yawn and sigh, pressing the tongue up into the hard palate.

title: Disney princess yawn
instructions: Yawn like a Disney princess — exaggerate the elegance.

title: Held sigh
instructions: Yawn and sigh, then hold the end of the sigh.

title: Gruff yawn-sigh
instructions: Yawn and sigh gruffly, so you feel it in your throat and chest.

title: Foghorn
instructions: Deep diaphragmatic breath. Purse lips into an 'o' and sustain a foghorn-like 'ooo'. Then a breathier 'ooo'. Then push from the diaphragm for a louder 'ooo'.
tip: When you notice you're speaking more quietly, check your diaphragmatic breathing and air support.

title: Siren with 'ng'
instructions: Make an 'ng' sound and slide pitch while keeping the sound continuous.

title: Woo (up)
instructions: Glide a 'woo' upward a few times.

title: Woo (down)
instructions: Glide a 'woo' downward a few times.

title: Woo (U shape)
instructions: Glide a 'woo' in a U shape (down then up) a few times.

title: A few yawns
instructions: Let yourself yawn a few times — real or fake. Feel the jaw open and the throat relax.
